d: Tennis legend Billie Jean King talks about wearing regular glasses her whole career, getting equal prize money for men and women at the US Open, winning the Battle of the Sexes in 1973 against Bobby Riggs, her friend Elton John pulling her on stage at Dodger Stadium to sing backup, Elton singing a song for her, going back to college to get her degree at 82 years old, Jimmy being a grandfather, and her new documentary Give Me the Ball!
